selection.rule: Dependency-complete first 24 questions from the question-sheet selection order.

questions.question: What kinds of living things are especially mentioned in this passage?
questions.answer: Plants and animals are especially mentioned.

questions.question: Which two groups of living things are used as special examples?
questions.answer: Plants and animals.

questions.question: What conclusion does the passage draw from this perfect creation?
questions.answer: It concludes that only one unique Creator with unlimited power can do it.

questions.question: Why is it amazing that living things are made in abundance?
questions.answer: Because even with so many of them, each one is still made properly.

questions.question: What can we understand from the fact that there is no confusion among many created beings?
questions.answer: We can understand that their Creator has perfect control.

questions.question: How does the passage compare creating stars and atoms?
questions.answer: It says both are equally easy for Allah.

questions.question: What comparison is made between the biggest things and the smallest things?
questions.answer: The biggest and the smallest are equally easy for Allah to create.

questions.question: What example shows that size does not matter to Allah’s power?
questions.answer: A towering tree and a seed smaller than a fingernail are both easy for Him to make.

questions.question: Write the main idea of the whole passage in one short sentence.
questions.answer: Allah creates all living things with perfect power, and nothing is hard for Him.

questions.question: What main lesson about Allah’s power should a student learn from this passage?
questions.answer: Allah’s power is perfect and unlimited, so creating many, great, or tiny things is all easy for Him.

questions.question: What is the main topic of this part of the passage?
questions.answer: It is about how Allah creates living things with perfect power, speed, and order.

questions.question: What does the passage say about ease and skill working together?
questions.answer: It says creation happens easily but still with amazing skill and care.

questions.question: Besides being fast and orderly, how else are living things made?
questions.answer: They are made with skill, care, ability, and beauty.

questions.question: How does the passage connect abundance with value?
questions.answer: It says things can be very many and still be precious and special.

questions.question: What kind of being is described as able to create in this way?
questions.answer: A single unique Being with unlimited power.

questions.question: What comparison is made between stars and atoms?
questions.answer: Creating stars is just as easy as creating atoms.

questions.question: What example shows life being given on two different levels?
questions.answer: The whole earth being brought to life and one tree being brought to life.

questions.question: Is the passage mainly about human effort or Divine power?
questions.answer: It is mainly about Divine power.

questions.question: What does the passage want us to notice by saying these deeds happen before our eyes?
questions.answer: It wants us to notice the clear signs of Allah in the world we see.

questions.question: In this passage, what is special about the way plants and animals are created?
questions.answer: They are created quickly, neatly, skillfully, and with great value.

questions.question: What does the passage say about the neatness of creation?
questions.answer: It says creation happens with complete order.

questions.question: What does the passage say about how they are created in large numbers?
questions.answer: They are created in large numbers without losing order or beauty.

questions.question: What result shows that this creation is perfect?
questions.answer: There is no confusion and no deficiency.

questions.question: What does the passage teach about that power?
questions.answer: It teaches that nothing is hard for that power.
